key_insight: SARLO-80 introduces a large-scale, worldwide very-high-resolution SAR–optical dataset that keeps native SAR information instead of reducing it to low-quality intensity images. This gives multimodal foundation models a much more physically faithful resource for learning from radar data.
problem_solved: Most public SAR–optical datasets are limited by low resolution, GRD-only products, and the loss of complex-valued SAR measurements and acquisition geometry. The paper addresses the lack of a high-quality dataset for physically grounded SAR-language-optical multimodal research.
method: Curates a worldwide dataset of VHR SAR and optical pairs at 80 cm resolution.
Preserves complex-valued SAR measurements and native acquisition geometry instead of using intensity-only GRD representations.
Provides a scalable resource intended to support multimodal foundation model training and evaluation.
impact: For AI/ML practitioners, this dataset enables more realistic SAR understanding, cross-modal alignment, and downstream tasks that depend on radar physics. It should improve transfer learning, multimodal pretraining, and robust sensing applications in remote sensing.
